skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Charm of the Tiles
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Charm of the Tiles. Clothes Kestrel wears while having fun at the games teahouse. Culottes matched with a leather jacket and handbag draw out an elegant charm, while maximizing the wearer's easy-going attitude.
skins.quote: This is the first time she's playing this distinctive game, so sit down, order a pot of tea, and teach her the basics of making friends through tiles.
